subject.title: Follow-up: optimize fallback order + add model-input config guardrail

question: Should OpenClaw keep operator-ordered fallback lists as the source of truth, add a benchmark-backed fallback ranking policy, and how strict should configured model input capability validation be?
rationale: Current code and tests intentionally preserve ordered fallback lists and broad configured model input metadata, so changing either behavior needs maintainer product and compatibility intent before implementation.

options.title: Design policy and capability authority first
options.body: Keep this open while maintainers define cost/latency/quality ranking criteria and the trusted capability source for configured provider metadata.

options.title: Split remaining work by tracker
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/50287 for the guardrail subset and keep this issue only for benchmark-backed fallback ordering.

options.title: Defer ranking and only document diagnostics
options.body: Leave operator fallback ordering as-is for now and pursue non-breaking capability diagnostics before any fail-closed validation.

recommendation.title: Design policy and capability authority first
recommendation.body: Keep this open while maintainers define cost/latency/quality ranking criteria and the trusted capability source for configured provider metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal across current blame, configured image model history, fallback/config paths, and issue timeline involvement.
